answers.core: There are several addons but some are sketchy. Another thing is that various game engines provide this property built in, no need for self-compiling or stuff like that.
answers.workaround:
Well, yes. You could take a look at this https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.4/contributing/development/compiling/compiling_with_script_encryption_key.html
but the functionality should be within the editor, like other game engines.

title: Better encryption for games (provided within the editor)
